title: 第14章 这个女配有点惨（14）
slug: 恶毒女配又在作死发疯虐哭主角
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

亲生女儿将要被推进手术室摘肾

张澜这个当妈的也只有扭曲的快意，她特意凑过来，“我告诉你，沈璎，”

她的声音压得很低，低到只有沈璎能听见，“这颗肾，哪怕不匹配，你也得捐。

因为这里就是人间炼狱，所有进来的人，都是一个个供体，你不是那个例外，所以认命吧！”

她顿了顿，忽然笑了一声。那笑声冷得像从冰窖里渗出来的。

“说起来你那个死鬼老爸真不是东西，活着的时候不管家里只有他的破工作，死了也不消停。

我都已经和他没关系了，可是我老公身边那些人总说我是卧底，是来复仇的，说我来不是和阿崇安心过日子的。

你知道我花了多少年才让他们相信我吗？

你知道我这些年怎么过来的吗？

我闯过蛇窟，入过荒漠，杀过警察……为了爱他，我连人性都丢了。

我爱他，更爱他的女儿。

可你呢？就因为嫉妒就一次次害她。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

My biological daughter will be pushed into the operating room to have her kidney removed.

Zhang Lan, a mother, only had twisted pleasure. She came over specially and said, "I'm telling you, Shen Ying,"

Her voice was very low, so low that only Shen Ying could hear it, "You have to donate this kidney even if it doesn't match.

Because this is purgatory on earth, and everyone who comes in is a donor. You are not the exception, so accept your fate!"

She paused and suddenly laughed.The laughter was as cold as oozing out of an ice cellar.

"Speaking of which, that damn dad of yours is really nothing. When he was alive, he didn't care if there was only his lousy job in the house, and he wouldn't stop even after he died.

I have nothing to do with him anymore, but the people around my husband always say that I am an undercover agent, here for revenge, and that I am not here to live peacefully with A Chong.

Do you know how many years it took me to get them to believe me?

Do you know how I got here all these years?

I broke into snake dens, entered the desert, and killed policemen... In order to love him, I even lost my humanity.

I love him and his daughter even more.

But what about you?He hurt her again and again just because of jealousy.
